top_signals.title: Anthropic Shares Indicated to Open 25% Above IPO
top_signals.summary:
Anthropic shares are set to soar when they start trading on Thursday, after the AI lab’s $107.3 billion IPO and private placement broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

The company behind the Claude chatbot and its seven co-founders raised $81.3 billion in an IPO priced above range, topping SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever first time share sale, and another $26 billion in a concurrent private placement. The deal values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

The lineup of investors in Anthropic’s private placement is a who’s who of the AI trade, including Nvidia Alphabet’s Google, Microsoft and Advanced Micro Devices, according to its filings, a reflection of the tight relationships within the sector.

Sarah Frier, Bloomberg Managing Editor for Technology Coverage, discusses Anthropic's bet on an enterprise use case for AI with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney, Scarlet Fu, and John Tucker. (Source: Bloomberg)
